errors.text: The proposed intervention—adding size-mismatched elements—is not the target intervention of inducing chemical short-range order in an otherwise fixed HfNbTaTiZr alloy.

The predicted direction is opposite to the target result: the target finds that SRO reduces lattice distortion and increases lattice thermal conductivity by about 12%, rather than increased distortion lowering it.
The cited irradiation studies do not provide evidence that lattice distortion reduces phonon thermal conductivity.

Changing alloying elements confounds lattice distortion with composition, phase stability, electronic transport, defects, and microstructure, so the proposed experiment cannot isolate the claimed mechanism.
Temperature and material-state boundaries are not specified in testable terms.
